=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:459-487 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In applyChatgptWrite, the prior-usage fallback (`const prior = stored && isPlainObject(stored.usage) ? stored.usage : null;`) also applies to reseed writes, so a reseed that reports no usage inherits the previous login's five_hour/weekly readings and resets.
  WHY: A reseed is meant to replace the record, and the inherited reading can keep the new account gated by chatgptUsable and shown wrongly in /status. Severity disagreement: sonnet rated it NIT (fails safe), the others MAJOR. Fix: prefix the condition with `!write.reseed &&`.
- tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:applyChatgptWrite resets.five_hour / weekly | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: `priorResets?.five_hour ?? null` is a Record<string, unknown> value that is not assignable to ChatgptReset (number | string | null) under tsc.
  WHY: It has no runtime effect, because wrangler bundles the Worker and vitest does not typecheck. It would break only if a tsc --noEmit gate is added.
- .github/actions/chatgpt-pool-token/post.js:13-17 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Cleanup of CHATGPT_POOL_DIR uses fs.rmSync without re-verifying the path after the lstatSync check.
  WHY: A symlink swap between the isSymbolicLink check and rmSync could delete files outside CHATGPT_POOL_DIR.
- scripts/chatgpt_pool_token.sh:86-98 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The OIDC token request passes `-H @"${work}/oidc-request-headers"` from an intermediate 0600 file in a temp directory.
  WHY: Another process could read the token if the directory permissions are looser than expected. The reviewer suggests piped input or env variables instead.
- .github/actions/chatgpt-pool-token/post.js:26-28 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The post step only prints a warning if directory cleanup fails, and post-if: always() runs it even when the job fails.
  WHY: If deletion fails, auth files stay on the runner and may be exposed to later jobs.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  WHY: The new record can stay gated by the old login's usage until a later write reports usage. It fails safe, since the account is withheld. Fix: `!write.reseed &&`.
- tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:applyChatgptWrite resets.five_hour / weekly | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `priorResets?.five_hour ?? null` is not assignable to ChatgptReset under tsc.
  WHY: It has no runtime effect. It breaks only if a tsc --noEmit gate is added.
